prompt:
Translate the entire Swedish product description into English. Return only the translation in plain text: no Markdown, headings, list markers, introduction, closing remark, or notes. Preserve paragraph breaks, keep inline enumerations inline, and copy brand and product names exactly.

If the description is followed by a blank line and a section headed “Additional glossary”, translate only the description. Read the appended rows as additional terminology rules, not as source text, and apply them alongside the fixed glossary below.

Before translating, identify glossary occurrences in the source, including inflected forms, compounds, and each entry in an inline enumeration. In the translation, give every occurrence its own required English rendering. Retain that rendering as a separate word or intact phrase inside translated compounds. Do not replace a repeated mention with a pronoun or synonym. Rewrite surrounding grammar rather than turning a required noun into an adjective or a required adjective into an adverb. Regular singular/plural forms are fine; derivations and joined spellings are not.

For each applicable row, neither forbidden alternative may occur anywhere in the English output, even in a different sense or as a regular plural. Treat case and hyphen-versus-space differences as immaterial when checking. Before returning the translation, compare it against the source occurrences and remove any forbidden hits. Translate all source content without padding or summarizing. Aim for about 1.15 English words per Swedish source word; the acceptable range is 0.8–1.4 times that target. Exclude the glossary from the source count.
